description: This file provides utility functions for handling UNIX socket endpoints, including creating listeners, parsing endpoints, and establishing dialers, specifically supporting UNIX socket protocol with fallback handling.

methods.name: CreateListener
methods.description: Creates a UNIX socket listener on the specified endpoint, handling socket file cleanup and temporary socket creation.

methods.name: GetAddressAndDialer
methods.description: Returns the socket address and a dial function for connecting via UNIX socket.
